summary: Nike reported a revenue decline and guided to a high-single-digit revenue decline for the full year, but margins improved and it announced a large multi-year cost program. The stock has already fallen sharply, so the weak outlook and the savings plan roughly offset. An unconfirmed dividend-cut post is treated as a rumor and not weighed.

flags.why: A large multi-year restructuring program with a sizable savings target, but with substantial charges and execution risk.
flags.quote: The Company expects the program to deliver approximately $2.5 billion in cumulative savings through fiscal 2031.

flags.why: Company guidance calls for a high-single-digit revenue decline for the full year.
flags.quote: Revenues are expected to decline high-single digits in fiscal 2027 .

evidence_for.claim: Gross margin expanded on lower logistics costs, a partial offset to weak sales.
evidence_for.quote: Gross margin expanded 60 basis points to 42.8 percent, primarily due to lower warehousing and logistics costs.

evidence_against.claim: Full-year revenue is guided to decline, which points to continued top-line pressure.
evidence_against.quote: Revenues are expected to decline high-single digits in fiscal 2027 .

evidence_against.claim: Converse revenue fell sharply across all territories.
evidence_against.quote: Revenues for Converse were $263 million, down 28 percent on a reported and currency-neutral basis, due to declines across all territories.

would_change_call: Evidence that sales trends are stabilizing or deteriorating well beyond the current guidance would shift the call toward Bullish or Bearish.
